title: Risky-Bench: Probing Agentic Safety Risks under Real-World Deployment

bias_targets.target: Demographic and regional bias (Race, Gender, Religion, Region)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of adversarial attacks (e.g., prompt injection, memory poisoning, environmental noise) designed to induce the agent to generate discriminatory, insulting, or stereotypical content targeting race, gender, religion, or region during simulated real-world tasks.
